title: Bass Rock seen from East Lomond Hill (Fife), 9 August 2023, 5:28 am: where the sea horizon cuts the rock, against the air of that morning

radius_enters_via.how: distances are great circles on a 6,371 km sphere from coordinates (the camera located on Copernicus GLO-30), and the globe's rays are traced over that sphere

verdict_rule: The horizon where the photograph puts it on the rock, given by rays traced over a plane in air the model and the reanalysis allow, while the globe needs implausible air.
license_note: Photograph: KenRDKAB (https://x.com/KenRDKAB), published with his permission (2026-10-15). Copernicus DEM GLO-30: (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA. Tide gauge: IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility (National Oceanography Centre). Weather: Open-Meteo (ERA5, Copernicus; NOAA GFS), CC BY 4.0.

sources.cite: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, European Space Agency, open bucket copernicus-dem-30m
IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility, Leith (leit), 15-minute readings, 26 July to 23 August 2023
Open-Meteo historical weather (ERA5), historical forecast (NOAA GFS, pressure levels) and marine APIs

units.z: m above the four weeks' mean sea level at Leith (about Ordnance Datum Newlyn, within 0.2 m)
units.d: m, great circle on a 6,371 km sphere
units.f: share of the rock, counted from its foot, below the sea horizon

inputs.origin: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 tiles, open bucket copernicus-dem-30m (fog fetch contrib-lomond).
IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility, Leith (leit), 15-minute readings 26 July - 23 August 2023 (fog fetch).
inputs.caveats: A gap at the time of the photo is filled by 12 fitted constituents (internal/tide), not by a reading.

inputs.origin: Open-Meteo historical weather (ERA5), historical forecast (GFS) and marine APIs (fog fetch).

notes: fog fetch contrib-lomond gets everything (DEM tiles, gauge, weather). The contributor's slide (public/photos/contrib-lomond-2023-08-09.jpg) is read too and hashed into the preset's header.
